# MapLibre GL JS 6.18.0

Source: official npm package `maplibre-gl@6.18.0` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/maplibre-gl).
License: 3-Clause BSD; complete package license is in `MAPLIBRE-LICENSE.txt`.
Documentation: https://maplibre.org/maplibre-gl-js/docs/.

The production ESM bundle, worker and CSS are served locally. Module filenames
use `.js` so Windows static servers return the JavaScript MIME type. Only the
relative worker/shared module filenames and unavailable source-map comments were
adjusted; library logic was not modified. Original and installed hashes are in
`maplibre-manifest.json`. No CDN JavaScript or Mapbox access token is required.

Map tiles remain from OpenStreetMap; its attribution is displayed on the map.
